properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 10:43PM PDT until October 22 at 2:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Western Ventura County in southwestern California...

* WHEN...Until 200 AM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1042 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Rock slides and mud slides are possible, especially on mountain
roads.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Oxnard, Ventura, Ojai, Santa Paula, Rose Valley, Lockwood Valley,
La Conchita, Ventura Harbor, Rincon Point, Highway 33 between
Wheeler Springs and Rose Valley Road, Meiners Oaks, Reyes Peak,
Lake Casitas, Solimar Beach, Seacliff, Highway 33 from Lockwood
Valley Road to the Santa Barbara County line and El Rio.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 AM PDT THURSDAY
